faq.q: What is the origin of Bishr?
faq.a: Bishr is associated with Arabic. Bishr ('human being'; also 'good news'), borne by Bishr al-Ḥāfī (d. 841), a celebrated early Sufi. The source record's gloss 'Swift, Quick' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form بشر is Arabic.
